SELECT own_addr_country_cd AS country, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_addr_country_cd NOT IN ('', 'US') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many papers have been withdrawn from PubMed's records?
SELECT count(*) AS deletions FROM govblock_health.pubmed_deletions
Which utilities sold the most electricity to industrial customers in 2020?

SELECT column02 AS utility, column06 AS state, try_cast(sales_2 AS double) AS industrial_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many sections of New York regulations are in the library?
SELECT count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'ny' AND document_type = 'regulation'
Which job titles appear most often among insiders who report trades?
SELECT rptowner_title, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_reportingowner WHERE rptowner_title <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of patents receive some adjustment to their term?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double) > 0) / count(*), 1) AS pct_adjusted FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which kinds of molecules does ChEMBL hold?
SELECT molecule_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE molecule_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much in deposits did FDIC-insured banks hold at the end of 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(dep AS double)) AS deposits_thousands FROM govblock_finance.fdic_financials WHERE cast(repdte AS varchar) = '20241231'
Which customer sectors have the most utility rate schedules?
SELECT sector, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE sector IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of PubChem bioassays are confirmatory tests?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN aid2activityoutcomemethod = 'Confirmatory' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2activityoutcomemethod
Which agencies pass the most federal awards on to the organisations they fund?
SELECT passthrough_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_passthrough WHERE passthrough_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many substations operate at 500 kilovolts or more?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations WHERE try_cast(max_volt AS double) >= 500
Which sources have deposited the most substances in PubChem?
SELECT c1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_substance_sid_map WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who is listed as the chief officer of Cornell University?
SELECT instnm, chfnm, chftitle FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd WHERE instnm LIKE 'Cornell University%' LIMIT 5
How are GDB-11's molecules spread across sizes, by number of heavy atoms?
SELECT heavy_atoms, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb11 WHERE heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many coal-fired units reported to EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type LIKE 'Coal%'
Which grid operators generated the most electricity from natural gas in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_natural_gas AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were there more road deaths in 2019, before the pandemic, or in 2021?
SELECT year, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2021') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which journals charge authors the highest publication fees?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(apc_usd AS double) AS fee_usd FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many water discharge inspections were carried out by EPA itself rather than a state?
SELECT count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections WHERE state_epa_flag = 'E'
In which states are the companies that own the most U.S. patents based?

SELECT l.disambig_state AS state, count(DISTINCT a.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_location_disambiguated l ON l.location_id = a.location_id WHERE cast(a.assignee_type AS varchar) = '2' AND l.disambig_country = 'US' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York City's highest hourly electricity load in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which specialties have the most clinicians opting out of Medicare?
SELECT specialty, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median age of people living in Maine?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US23' AND variable = 'B01002_E001'
Which larger auto insurers had the worst complaint ratios in New York in 2024?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings

SELECT company_name, try_cast(ratio AS double) AS complaint_ratio FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2024' AND try_cast(premiums_written_in_millions AS double) >= 10 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many days did an OIRA review take on average in 2023?

SELECT round(avg(date_diff('day', date(substr(cast(date_received AS varchar), 1, 10)), date(substr(cast(date_completed AS varchar), 1, 10)))), 1) AS avg_days FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed WHERE cast(date_completed AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Where is homeownership highest among the states?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B25003_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B25003_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_owner_occupied FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25003' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many state law sections were last amended in 2025?
SELECT count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE cast(last_amended_year AS varchar) = '2025'
Which states have the most citizens of voting age?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many adverse drug event reports received in 2019 involved a death?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_event WHERE seriousnessdeath = '1' AND substr(receivedate, 1, 4) = '2019'
Which reactors were shut down for the longest stretch in 2022?
SELECT trim(unit) AS unit, count(*) AS days_at_zero FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2022 %' AND try_cast(power AS double) = 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Where did New York's electricity come from in 2023, fuel by fuel?

SELECT fuel_category, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the highest poverty rates?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_poverty FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b17001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many different marketplace plans were sold in Texas in 2021?
SELECT count(DISTINCT planid) AS plans FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE statecode = 'TX' AND cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021'
Which New York cities have the most public schools?
SELECT lcity, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE st = 'NY' AND school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. coal consumption change from 2005 to 2023?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.CLTCB.US.A' AND period IN ('2005', '2023') ORDER BY 1
Which world regions post the most physics job openings on INSPIRE?
SELECT regions, count(*) AS jobs FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_jobs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the price power plants paid for natural gas change from January to December 2020?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT month, avg(try_cast(fuel_cost AS double)) AS avg_cost FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE fuel_group = 'Natural Gas' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND try_cast(month AS integer) IN (1, 12) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY try_cast(month AS integer) LIMIT 10
Which grids drew the most power from nuclear plants in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_nuclear AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. crude oil exports change from January 2015 to January 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_barrels_per_day FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.MCREXUS2.M' AND period IN ('201501', '202401') ORDER BY 1
On what grounds do federal civil cases most often claim jurisdiction?
SELECT jurisdiction_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE jurisdiction_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many business establishments were there in Harris County, Texas, at the end of 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT try_cast(qtrly_estabs AS double) AS establishments FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '48201' AND own_code = '0' AND industry_code = '10' AND year = '2023' AND qtr = '4'
Which New York public schools have the most students?

SELECT sch_name, try_cast(student_count AS double) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' AND st = 'NY' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many injuries have owners of the Tesla Model 3 reported in their complaints?
SELECT sum(try_cast(injured AS integer)) AS injured FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE maketxt = 'TESLA' AND modeltxt = 'MODEL 3'
Which research concepts are tagged on the most works?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_concepts ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rural health clinic cost reports cover fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_rhc17_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Where in a patent are compounds found most often: description, claims, abstract, title or images?

SELECT f.field_name, count(*) AS mentions FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patent_compound_map AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_fields AS f ON cast(f.id AS varchar) = cast(m.field_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
